user.title: Bulgarian Natural Gas Regulated Pricing
user.description: Choose the Overgas supply area your home is connected to. The tariff is published monthly by Overgas, and converted from MWh to cubic metres using the representative calorific value set by Bulgartransgaz.

data_description.vat_rate: Applied to the published net tariff. Bulgarian households pay 20%.

abort.already_configured: This supply area is already set up.

data.allow_direct: Read the sources directly if the published data is unavailable

data_description.vat_rate: Applied to the published net tariff. Bulgarian households pay 20%.
data_description.allow_direct: Off by default. Prices are normally read from a single published file, so a parser fix reaches every installation at once. If that file is missing a month, the usual cause is that an operator changed their document format — in which case reading the sources here would hit the same problem, unseen.

options.mrezhi: Sofia and other Overgas Mrezhi areas

stale_tariff.title: Bulgarian gas tariff is out of date
stale_tariff.description: Home Assistant is still using the tariff published for {period}, because the current month's document could not be read from Overgas. Gas costs are being calculated at the old price. Check {url} and report an issue if the page has changed format.

unsupported_data_version.title: Bulgarian gas pricing needs updating
unsupported_data_version.description: The published price data uses a newer format than this version of the integration can read, so the last known figures are still in use. Update the integration in HACS.
